name: medieval-manuscripts
description: Manuscript cataloguing: Latin alongside English ('saec. XIV', 's. xiv med.', 'c. 1400'), strict centuries (the 14th century is 1301-1400 as palaeographers count), bare two- and three-digit years are years (MinYearDigits 3 keeps 'c. 950' a year), hedged dates widened by ten years each way.
